definitions.explanation: The area or environment around something or someone.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}の{周|まわ}りにはお{店|みせ}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are many shops around the station.

examples.japanese: {周|まわ}りを{見|み}てください。
{周|まわ}りの{人|ひと}に{迷惑|めいわく}をかけないで。
examples.english: Don't bother the people around you.

notes:
{周|まわ}り means the area surrounding something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜の{周|まわ}り: around ~
- {周|まわ}りを{見|み}る: to look around
- {周|まわ}りの{人|ひと}: people around (oneself)

ALTERNATE KANJI: Also written as {回|まわ}り

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {周囲|しゅうい}: surroundings (more formal)
- {辺|あた}り: vicinity, area around
